packageRules.description: Split knip out of the npm non-major group. knip's transitive graph (oxc-parser, formatly, get-tsconfig, picomatch, ...) has broken Renovate's own lockfile regeneration when bundled with unrelated bumps (#397); isolating it keeps a bad artifact update from blocking the rest of the group.

Move the Playwright npm packages, the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image that runs the website-browser job, and the job's PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE_VERSION (via the custom manager) as one unit. The image carries the matching browser builds, so a solo bump of either side leaves the job running against mismatched browsers.

app/compat is a test-only module that decodes redacted responses into the real Docker client types. Its replace directive points at the main module, so Renovate must not chase that require. docker/docker stays on v28 on purpose: that is the last line before the client moved to moby/moby/api, and the module exists to test both. The nested go.mod can lag when the root module moves; CI's "Check app/compat go.mod is tidy" step reports that drift explicitly, and the fix is go mod tidy in app/compat.

customManagers.description: Bump PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE_VERSION in ci-verify.yml with playwright-core, so the grouped playwright PR passes the website-browser guard step.
